name: Bao & Stitch
tagline: Tiny plushies and pop-up cards, made to look like your mascot.
bio: I'm Mai. By day I do product design; nights and weekends I sew plushies and cut paper. Send me a mascot, a logo or a photo of your team and I'll turn it into something people hug. Every plush is drafted, sewn and stuffed by hand in my Brooklyn studio.

shop.title: Weekend plush drop
shop.note: Small batch, sewn this week. Each one has a slightly different face.
shop.where: Pickup in Greenpoint, or I ship

items.name: Sleepy toast plush
items.desc: A slice of toast with a nap face. 15 cm.

items.name: Dumpling buddy
items.desc: Soft, squishy, pleated on top. 12 cm.

items.name: Pop-up thank-you card
items.desc: A paper bouquet springs up when you open it.

experiences.name: Sew-your-own mini plush, for your team
experiences.desc: Everyone sews and stuffs a small plush from a pre-cut kit, in your mascot's colors if you like. No sewing experience needed.
includes: Needles, thread, stuffing and felt faces
Help from me the whole time
experiences.allIn: Kits, travel in NYC and tax.
runOfShow: 0:15 Running stitch and how to close a seam

giftNote: Your mascot, your colors, their name on the tag. You get a hand-sewn prototype to approve before I make the rest.

gifts.name: Your mascot, as a plushie
gifts.desc: I turn your mascot, logo creature or bot into a 20 cm plush with an embroidered face and a sewn-in tag with the recipient's name.
gifts.ships: Ships anywhere, each to its own address
gifts.allIn: Prototype, gift box and name tags included.

gifts.name: Mini-me team plush
gifts.desc: Each teammate as a small plush bear with their hair color, glasses and your team hoodie. A new-hire gift people keep on their desk for years.

gifts.name: Pop-up card in your brand
gifts.desc: Laser-cut paper layers that rise when the card opens: your HQ skyline, your product or your mascot, with their name written inside.
gifts.ships: Mailed with a real stamp, or boxed to your office
personalize: Your logo or skyline in paper

gifts.name: Pop-up launch invite
gifts.desc: An invitation that opens into your launch: a paper rocket, the date and the place. Hard to throw away.
